# Security policy

Spacement PVExtent is developed and maintained by Valeford.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please report suspected security vulnerabilities privately through either of
these channels:

- Email **[paul.roder@valeford.de](mailto:paul.roder@valeford.de)**.
- Use the **[Valeford contact form](https://valeford.de/contact)** and identify
  the message as a Spacement PVExtent security report.

Please avoid public issues or pull requests containing vulnerability details
until a fix or coordinated disclosure is available.

Include the affected version or commit, the relevant environment and
dependencies, reproduction steps or a minimal proof of concept, and the
potential impact. Redact credentials, personal information, and private data.

Valeford will review the report and coordinate investigation, remediation,
and disclosure with the reporter. Let us know whether and how you would like
to be credited in any public advisory.

## Supported versions

PVExtent is an early research project with no stable release or released model
checkpoint. Security fixes currently target the latest code on `main`.
Supported release lines will be documented here when stable versions exist.
